result:
If I were allowed one edit to the world, I’d make cruelty impossible to rationalize away.

Not by forcing people to be good, but by making the pain they cause unmistakably real to them—felt, seen, understood at the moment they choose to inflict it. Most evil doesn’t begin as monsterhood. It begins as distance: “they deserve it,” “it’s not that bad,” “I won’t have to look at it.” Remove that distance, and the world changes overnight.
